sgLetter.name: Vihaan Tallamraju
paragraphs: It is my immense pleasure to welcome you to the 14th Edition of the Oakridge Junior Model United Nations, taking place on 30th and 31st October 2026.

For over a decade, Oakridge JMUN has brought together young minds from numerous schools and diverse backgrounds to engage with global issues, challenge perspectives and experience the world of debate. What began as a conference has grown into a community built on leadership, collaboration and the courage to make your voice heard.

As Secretary-General, I am honoured to lead this year’s conference alongside a Secretariat that has worked tirelessly to make this experience as memorable as possible. Our aim is not simply to conduct two days of committee sessions but to create an environment where every delegate has the opportunity to question and contribute meaningfully.

I still remember what it felt like to walk into a committee not knowing exactly what to expect. Those first few speeches, difficult discussions and stressful debates that once felt overwhelming have become some of my most valuable experiences.

Model United Nations is about far more than knowing foreign policy or delivering a speech. It is about understanding perspectives different from your own, standing by your ideas with conviction and learning to approach challenges with an open mind. It is through these moments of difference and disagreement that meaningful diplomacy begins.
Speak when you have something to contribute. Listen when someone else has a perspective you have not considered and most importantly, take every opportunity to learn.

I hope that through Oakridge JMUN 2026, you take with you more than resolutions and certificates by making meaningful connections, having greater confidence in your own voice and the motivation to continue engaging with the world around you.
On behalf of the entire Secretariat, I extend my welcome to each and every one of you.
We look forward to two days of passionate debate and unforgettable experiences.
